A recently divorced woman meets a kind, caring, and nurturing father. Despite her reservations against getting into a new relationship, she falls in love. However, she doesn't see what everyone else around her sees - that he is a killer.

title: Evil Lives Here

Kevin Currie is a devout follower of spiritual leader Jeffrey Lundgren, when he comes to realize Lundgren is really a devil in disguise who has hatched an evil plan.

title: American Monster

Raised in a big Mormon family, Ashlee Harmon grows up wanting that same kind of lifestyle; she marries her college boyfriend, Emmett Corrigan, and raises five kids while he opens his own law firm, but dirty secrets soon trigger a deadly showdown.

title: American Monster
description:

As gentle giant Randy Ferguson approaches his 40th birthday, his sisters worry that he'll never have a family of his own; that all changes when Randy meets single mom Angela Phillips; but the beautiful life they build together hides an ugly secret.

title: American Monster
description:

Michelle Lira dreams of being a doctor, until one day a rollercoaster romance steers her life in a different direction, straight into a deadly ambush.

title: American Monster
description:

In Hudson, Wis., Charlene and Darrell Wold seem to be living a blissful existence with their blended family; they do all they can to keep their household safe and secure, but they never imagined the real danger would come from within.

title: American Monster
description:

title: American Monster

title: Murder Calls
description:

title: 911: Did the Killer Call
description:

title: 911: Did the Killer Call
description:

A woman falls to her death in the Rockies, her husband calls 911; the police must find out whether her death was really an accident or was she pushed; a three-year-old is found dead in a river; her father calls 911, he becomes the prime suspect.

title: 911: Did the Killer Call
description:
S01 E01 — Suspect #1
Three horrific murders. Three different 911 calls. All three callers claim they're innocent - but for the police, the call can reveal so much more than just the facts of the case. Find out which of them is the real killer in disguise.

California beauty Pegye meets volleyball player Eric in Newport Beach, Calif.; with good looks and success, the couple appears to have it all, but hedonism comes at a price, and their dream life quickly becomes a waking nightmare.

title: Fatal Vows

A minister's son, Luther, falls hard for Anita, the daughter of a pastor; then, failure delivers a crushing blow to their relationship, turning their heavenly life into hell on Earth.

A Virginia man insists, What's mine is mine, and what's yours is mine.

A former cop is moving into a close-knit neighborhood; conflict arises with the whole community over dogs, noise, and other disturbances that keep piling on and ratcheting up until a boiling point is reached, guns are drawn, and blood is spilled.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:

Teenagers find a woman's corpse while attending a party on the outskirts of the city; detectives quickly determine that the victim was strangled with her own shoelace, but they struggle to identify her.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:

description:

In Payette, Idaho, teacher Elizabeth Baune is the pillar of her community until she is stabbed to death in her own home; townspeople suspect Baune's kindness may have been behind her death.

description:

Lt. Joe Kenda must put his faith in a burglar to crack the case of a drive-by shooting; Cherie Bradley and her ex-boyfriend Anthony Carroll are found dead, and it's up to Kenda to discover which of their relatives did the deed.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:

Led astray by addiction, George Ferribee is found executed, then Lt. Joe Kenda learns the victim had recently been kidnapped and assumes the two crimes are related, but Kenda soon discovers things are much more complicated than he had expected.

description:

A star athlete is gunned down just weeks before starting college, leaving his family heartbroken and detectives stumped; Lt. Joe Kenda pries into the victim's personal life and learns more about his last night on Earth.

description:
